ICS: Did the teacher obtain a commitment from the learner (i.e. teacher asks question that requires learner to provide a proposed assessment/diagnosis/treatment)?
Did the teacher explore the student’s rationale for their answers?
Did the teacher reinforce or give positive feedback for things done well?
Was the teacher able to teach a general principle? (versus specific facts)
Did the teacher make good eye contact with the learner?
Did the teacher use hand gestures while speaking?
Did the teacher listen, as well as talk?
Did the teacher use good facial expression and show lots of energy in the discussion?
